intro: One medium mango has about 200 kcal. Most of the calories come from natural sugar, because ripe mango is very sweet and has a lot of flesh.
diet: Yes, just watch the portion. One big mango can have the same calories as a small plate of rice. Share one with your partner or kids, half is already very satisfying. The ones to be more careful with are mango sticky rice and sweetened juice.
tips: Cut the mango in half and keep the other half for tomorrow.
Eat mango as dessert instead of a sweet drink or kuih, not on top of them.
Pair it with unsweetened yogurt for a higher-protein snack.

swap.name: Half a mango + half a bowl of papaya
swap.why: You still get the sweet mango taste, but total calories drop and your plate still looks full.

faq.a: Many people feel that way, but there's no strong evidence. If you eat too much at once, your stomach may feel uncomfortable, so eat in moderation.

faq.q: Can people with diabetes eat mango?
faq.a: Many can eat small portions, like a few slices, together with other food. Best to follow your doctor or dietitian's advice.

faq.q: Young or ripe mango, which has less sugar?
faq.a: Young mango is usually less sweet. But if you dip it in rojak sauce or sugar, the calories can end up higher.
